description: Exploratory comparison over all 729 published XG opening/reply positions and all 2,584 listed candidate values. Engines generate their own root moves. No XG values, fitted offsets, or post-hoc corrections enter evaluation. This is a selected opening corpus and not a general playing-strength benchmark. XG has Jacoby and immediate redoubles; GNUbg ordinary and PureTD use Jacoby without beavers/raccoons; GNUbg beavers-on and Sage have beavers without raccoons. Deterministic tree/model estimates are compared with finite published XG rollouts or XGRoller++ estimates; small differences are not exact ground truth. Native timing is exploratory and not a controlled speed comparison.

matchedBook.method: Same historical 666 positions and 1,494 common candidate values. Historical GNUbg 4/5-ply book finalists vs current independent full-root PureTD wide 1-ply. Root filtering differs. No historical values are rewritten.

metadata.context: Jacoby, beavers only. Raccoons not included. All legal root moves scored at two GNU plies with internal pruning. Offline native diagnostic; root policy differs from Sage default so timing is not a like-for-like speed comparison.

Jacoby, no beavers or raccoons. Ordinary money rules matching PureTD. All legal root moves scored at two GNU plies with internal pruning. Offline native diagnostic; root policy differs from Sage default so timing is not a like-for-like speed comparison.

metadata.method: Exploratory native single-thread default checker search. No XG-forced candidates; reference used only after search. Validate all legal afterboards. Sage lacks raccoon branches: context not fully identical to XG. Time includes warm-cache analysis, excludes initialization, and is not a controlled speed comparison.
